The following events took place in '''70 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Kira Run]] is discovered on 4:18<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|52||Today in History}}</ref> by the [[Haik Expedition]].<ref name="TSoK">[[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']]</ref> {{C|Approximate date}}
*[[Mining/Legends|Mining]] industry collapses on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SoT">''[[Secrets of Tatooine]]''</ref>
*An [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] [[Unidentified Iktotchi prophet|prophet]] settles on [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]].<ref name="Darth P">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>

==Births==
*[[Savielk Trey'dra]]<ref name="SEPG">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>
*[[Jorus C'baoth]]<ref name="Cbaoth">C'baoth's birthdate was originally given in ''[[Dark Force Rising]]'' as being 112 Pre-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] (which would work out to 131 BBY) based on records in the archives on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. This was later [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] to [[70 BBY]] in the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook]]''.</ref>
